proposals.evidence: The full DEDR 5548 article records Ta. vēṟu other, that which is different, that which is separated, class, kind, enmity, that which is opposite; vēṟu-paṭu, vēṟ-ā to become different, separate, etc.; vēṟu-pāṭu difference,…. The K1 form continues this article's different (other) sense.

proposals.evidence: The full DEDR 1124 article records Ta. kaṭi (-pp-, -tt-) to bite, bite off, bite and eat, gnaw, nibble, champ, hurt; n. biting, scar of a bite; kaṭippu scar of a bite. Ma. kaṭikka to bite, chew, smart, pain, cheat; kaṭiyuka to be…. The K1 form continues this article's it (the doɡ) bit sense.
